description: Saudi air defenses successfully intercepted a ballistic missile launched by Yemen's Houthi militia targeting the Eastern Province, marking yet another recent aerial threat amid ongoing conflict involving Iran. description: Thick smoke and flames observed at Tehran’s oil refinery were due to safety flaring, with no fire reported. The flare systems were activated following electrical and technical issues.

description: The US defense industry does not face a shortage of capital, but structural barriers that prevent investment from reaching critical areas, according to a report by Bain  Company and the Aerospace Industries Association. description: Iran has executed three men accused of collaborating with Israel and the US during January protests. The judiciary confirmed the executions following Supreme Court approval.

description: A Russian attack damaged energy facilities in Ukraine’s eastern Dnipropetrovsk region, causing a widespread electricity outage affecting over 600,000 people.

description: Iran’s Revolutionary Guard says it has lifted a self-imposed limit of 2,000 kilometers (1,200 miles) on the range of its ballistic missiles, suggesting the country may seek to develop missiles capable of reaching more distant targets as fears of renewed all-out war rise. title: Tenerife honour teammate Jesus De Miguel with tearful tribute
description: Tenerife’s stadium filled up with thousands of mourners on Saturday where they held a tearful tribute to striker Jesus De Miguel, who passed away after colliding with a goalkeeper during a match, subsequently suffering a cardiac arrest. title: Strong earthquake shakes central Japan, shattering store windows and injuring at least 22
description: TOKYO: A strong earthquake shook central Japan early Sunday, shattering store windows, causing people to flee buildings and leaving at least 22 people injured, according to local media. title: Bulk carrier, military forces involved in latest Gulf of Oman incident, UKMTO says
description: A bulk carrier recently encountered military forces in the Gulf of Oman, as reported by the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO). This incident, among several others in the region, raises concerns about the safety of commercial shipping amid ongoing conflicts, particularly between the US and Iran. Investigations are underway, with the condition of the vessel's crew and potential environmental impact still unconfirmed.

title: Five expatriates arrested for illegal soil excavation in Eastern Province
description: Saudi Arabia's Special Forces for Environmental Security arrested five expatriates from Pakistan, Bangladesh, and Yemen for illegally exploiting natural deposits in the Eastern Province, seizing excavation equipment. This operation is part of a broader crackdown on environmental violations aimed at protecting the Kingdom's natural resources and enforcing environmental laws.
